The case split n=0 versus n≥1 is correct, and the injectivity argument is fully justified using distinct enumerations.
No semantic drift from the lemma sketch or the root theorem role is present; the lemma is exactly the standard finite-cardinality-to-injection fact needed downstream.

reason: The proof correctly handles the empty-set case and the nonempty finite case by enumerating distinct elements of A and B, defining f(a_i)=b_i for i≤n, and proving injectivity from the distinctness of the enumeration of B.
